title: Customizing Zscaler Client Connector with Install Options for Android

blocks.text: You can customize and deploy the Zscaler Client Connector to your users' devices by adding the app to the Mobile Device Management (MDM) used by your organization. The steps for downloading and deploying the app depends upon your MDM.
To install Zscaler Client Connecter on your Android devices, choose any one of the following deployment procedures:

blocks.item: Deploying Zscaler Client Connector with MaaS360 for Android
Deploying Zscaler Client Connector with Microsoft Intune for Android
Deploying Zscaler Client Connector with MobileIron for Android
Deploying Zscaler Client Connector with Workspace ONE UEM for Android
